body.name: Coherent cross-fitted nuisance system
body.construction: For each training fold, fit one label-aligned product factorization represented by \(\widehat\eta\); set \(\widehat W=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat w)\), \(\widehat B=\widehat M_A\odot\widehat M_Z\), \(\widehat d=\widehat B\widehat w\), \(\widehat D=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat d)\), \(\widehat R=\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B\widehat W\), \(\widehat N=I_{K^{2}}-\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B(\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B)^{+}\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\), \(\widehat h=\widehat N\widehat c\), and derive \(\widehat G\), \(\widehat b_{(\cdot)}\), \(\widehat b_U\), and \(\widehat Q\) from those same objects before held-out evaluation
